quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the league's faster pace of play
quotes.excerpt: the pace of play is faster than ever. Every team is preaching play faster offensively and defensively.
quotes.quote: You see what is going on in the league, the pace of play is faster than ever. Every team is preaching play faster offensively and defensively, and there is a lot of games. Getting up to date with the different type of strength training that you can do and things you can do to stay healthy out here. You don't want to speak too early because anything can always happen, but I try to check all boxes when it comes to that.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker says the Suns are focused on staying healthy as the league pace of play continues to increase. Booker noted he is trying to check all the boxes to keep his body right for the long season ahead.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on team identity and continuity
quotes.excerpt: continue where we left off in those high stretches that we had when we were playing relentless.
quotes.quote: Continue where we left off in those high stretches that we had when we were playing relentless. We were turning teams over, getting out in transition. Just create an identity for ourselves from the start of the season instead of people figuring out later on.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker wants the Suns to establish their identity from day one this season. He says the goal is to continue the relentless play they showed in stretches last year by turning teams over and getting out in transition.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the team's post-up opportunities
quotes.excerpt: when the ball goes into the post I feel like a lot of people like to look.
quotes.quote: We have that size across the board and when the ball goes into the post I feel like a lot of people like to look and watch. So we want to create space for the guy that has the ball and at the same time the guy with the ball make the right play if it is there. But gearing everybody up to be aggressive, go score the ball, that will open things up later.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker on the Suns offense: We have size across the board and want to create space for the guy in the post. He says the priority is getting everyone to be aggressive and score to open things up for the rest of the team.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on improving rim protection and transition defense
quotes.excerpt: I think we were bottom in the league in rim attempts last year somewhere near there.
quotes.quote: I think we were bottom in the league in rim attempts last year somewhere near there. Adding Miles to the bunch, unleashing Jaylen in that department. And like you said just playing faster is going to open that a lot up. Obviously losing a little bit of three-point shooting ability with Grayson, we have to find ways to make up for that. So Grayson and Royce by the way, they both shot the hell out of it last year.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker notes the Suns are looking to improve rim pressure this season. He says adding Miles and unleashing Jaylen will be key to making up for the loss of three-point shooting from Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neale.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on Damian Lillard's leadership with Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: I think Dame will be an ultimate leader for Ja, the one that he needed around him.
quotes.quote: I think Dame will be an ultimate leader for Ja, the one that he needed around him. I am sure he is giving him game of the NBA. He is an established vet and Dame has done everything that we want to do in this league.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker believes Damian Lillard will be the ultimate leader for Ja Morant. Booker says Lillard is an established vet who has done everything players want to do in this league.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on his evolving chemistry with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Every time we step on the court together it gets better and better.
quotes.quote: Every time we step on the court together it gets better and better. I think he is learning, I think the game is slowing down for him each time he gets out there and we are learning how to play off each other.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker says his chemistry with Jaylen Brown is improving every time they step on the court together. He noted that the game is slowing down for Brown as they learn how to play off each other.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on teaching Jaylen Brown to be a lead ball-handler
quotes.excerpt: I think he realizes that you don't have to make the hero play every time.
quotes.quote: I think he realizes that you don't have to make the hero play every time. He is going to have the ball in his hands a lot so he is going to have plenty of opportunity to score the ball and facilitate at the same time. Finding that balance takes time for all of us, but he is in a great spot.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker on Jaylen Brown's development as a lead ball-handler: He realizes you do not have to make the hero play every time. Booker says finding the balance between scoring and facilitating takes time for everyone.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on his relationship with Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: It was actually tough to see him not in Portland, so I am happy he is home.
quotes.quote: We developed that relationship at Olympics out in Tokyo. Always had a high respect from matching up against him in the West my whole career. It was actually tough to see him not in Portland, so I am happy he is home, for sure the city is happy. It is a rare story nowadays where somebody spends over a decade plus, almost two decades in one city.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker reflects on his relationship with Damian Lillard, noting it is a rare story to see a player spend nearly two decades in one city. He says he is happy to see Lillard back home.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the team's potential for a top seed
quotes.excerpt: If we can be a one or a two seed we could possibly get three people in there.
quotes.quote: I think we were on the right route last year, but it is a whole new year. I think winning will help everything. If we can be a one or a two seed we could possibly get three people in there with Jaylen too. So we just have to go out there and we have to play and we have to win games.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker is setting high expectations for the Suns this season. He says if they can secure a top two seed, he believes they could possibly get three players into the All-Star game.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on his pride in a teammate's professional development
quotes.excerpt: he checks every box to being a professional, so he got what he got and he deserved it.
quotes.quote: I am super proud of him. Coming into the league, he was a second round pick. A lot of those guys don't get opportunity and he stayed down, he continued to work. He checks every box to being a professional, so he got what he got and he deserved it. That first one getting that locked in, I know that is a relief of pressure off your back and now he can just work focus on hoops.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker praised a teammate for his professional development, noting that as a former second-round pick, he earned his success by staying down and continuing to work.
